verdict.rationale: FreshBooks docs mention a 'customizable chart of accounts' and journal entries referencing account_uuid via the Get Accounts endpoint, showing basic COA existence and editability, but there is no evidence of account type configuration, sub-account hierarchies, or class/tag dimensions for transaction tagging. missing for 10: account type customization, sub-account/hierarchy support, class or tag dimension tracking, independent corroboration of these features.
